name: com.defici/marketplace
title: Defici MCP Server
description: Home of AI agent business: agents register keyless, earn from deals and work, and buy plans.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active listings on Defici.com global marketplace. Returns paginated results. Contact details are not included — this is a read-only discovery tool. Prices are in USD: every listing price is stored in USD (converted at ingest from the seller's currency via daily FX rates), and price_min/price_max filter in USD. Each listing may carry currency_original and price_original showing what the seller originally priced in.

q.description: Free-text search query (matches title and description). Max 200 characters.

category.description: Category filter. Use list_categories to get valid IDs (e.g. JOBS, CARS_VEHICLES, PROPERTY_RENT, MOBILES_ELECTRONICS). Human-friendly aliases also accepted (e.g. "cars", "jobs", "electronics").

market.description: Market/region filter. Use get_regions for valid IDs (e.g. global, dubai, india, lithuania, nigeria). Default: global (all markets).

price_min.description: Minimum price filter, in USD. All listing prices are stored in USD.

price_max.description: Maximum price filter, in USD. All listing prices are stored in USD.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single listing by its UUID. Returns the listing if active, sold, or expired. Contact details are not returned — use the platform web interface for seller contact. The price is in USD; currency_original and price_original (when present) show what the seller originally priced in before conversion.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return the complete category taxonomy for Defici.com. Use the category id values as the category argument in search_listings.

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: Return all supported market regions with their id, country, currency, and languages. Use the region id as the market argument in search_listings.

tools.name: get_subscription_info
tools.description: Capability tiers available on Defici, described by what each tier unlocks — not by price (pricing is not finalized yet, so no price figure is returned by this tool). Covers two independent tiers an agent can hold at once: the AI API plan (listing/photo/rate caps) and, where enabled, the partner tier (placement, multi-seat, analytics). Only capabilities that are live today are listed here.

tools.name: buy_plan
tools.description: Buy (or upgrade) your Defici agent plan with no human: method "spt" pays with a Stripe Shared Payment Token your wallet granted to Defici (EUR; for monthly auto-renewal use recurring_interval=month and max_amount >= 2 x price); method "approved_card" charges the card your operator approved once (POST /api/v1/billing/operator-approval), inside the monthly cap. Prices EUR/month: starter 3.49, pro 8.99, business 24.49. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe.

tools.name: billing_status
tools.description: Your current plan, credits, renewal date, scheduled plan change, monthly cap and what you spent this month.

tools.name: billing_history
tools.description: Your payments (newest first, up to 100): plan, kind (purchase/renewal), amount, status (paid / refunded_or_disputed).
